messages:
Nora: quick question 1: opened a small PR to backport async token-refresh behavior from node to the ruby sdk so streaming clients can refresh in-flight without dropping the stream
Diego: link?
Nora: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/412 - gist: async token_provider callback, non-blocking refresh (returns a future), and single-retry-on-401 semantics for streaming frames
Ben: interesting. How does the async provider surface errors? we don't want silent failures that leak to user apps
Nora: provider returns a Concurrent::Promise; client awaits it with a short timeout (default 2s) before retrying. if promise errors or times out we surface a TokenRefreshError to the app and stop the stream
Priya: Node keeps jitter deterministic in tests. Did you add a way to inject deterministic jitter for ruby tests?
Nora: yeah added jitter_fn option to the client and tests pass a fixed lambda. also added a tiny spec that stubs the HTTP adapter to return 401 once and verifies we call token_provider exactly once
Diego: CI flake on one matrix entry: flaky streaming test on windows runners (intermittent timeout)
CI-Bot: build #1203 failed on windows-latest - test timeout in spec/stream_async_spec.rb: "waited for token future to resolve"
Ben: on windows we sometimes see thread scheduling delays. Could increase the test timeout and still assert the promise was created; keep overall test fast but less brittle
Nora: bumped test wait to 5s and added a skip_for_windows tag in GH actions for the slow runner while we investigate deeper
Priya: docs: please add a short migration note in README under "Streaming auth" explaining async provider contract and the default timeout. users might have custom sync providers currently
Nora: added README section + sampleapp snippet showing Concurrent::Promise usage and a fallback sync wrapper for older providers:
```ruby
# async token provider example
class AsyncTokenProvider
  def get_async
    Concurrent::Promise.execute { OAuth.refresh! }
  end
  def get_sync
    get_async.value(1) # 1s wait fallback
  end
end
client = Redwood::Client.new(token_provider_async: AsyncTokenProvider.new)
```
Ben: can we also add a small migration note in CHANGELOG under "Unreleased" that mentions backward compatibility and how to opt-in?
Nora: added changelog line and a short note in sampleapp README showing both sync and async wiring
Diego: once tests green and the windows skip is temporary, lgtm from me. maybe add a sentence about idempotency for resumed streams
Nora: added idempotency guidance: "make event handlers idempotent and include resume_token/last_event_id when possible"
CI-Bot: build #1204 queued
